file.content:
=== Image Scroll Reveal ===
Contributors: stronenv, WordPress Telex Tags: block, image, animation, scroll, comparison Tested up to: 6.8 Stable tag: 0.1.0 License: GPLv2 or later License URI: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
Create stunning scroll-triggered image reveal animations with customizable directions and fade effects.
== Description ==
The Image Scroll Reveal block allows you to create engaging image comparison experiences that respond to user scrolling. Display two overlapping images where the top image gradually reveals the bottom image as users scroll down the page.
Perfect for: * Before and after comparisons * Product reveals * Portfolio showcases * Interactive storytelling * Design transformations
Key Features: * Smooth scroll-triggered animations that start when the block enters the viewport * Four reveal directions: left, right, top, and bottom * Customizable fade transition width for smooth blending * Adjustable fade effect styles * Full WordPress image block settings support (alt text, dimensions, borders, spacing, links) * Responsive design that maintains aspect ratios * Easy-to-use editor interface with drag-and-drop image uploads
The animation begins automatically when the block enters the viewport and completes when it reaches 30% from the top of the screen, creating a natural and engaging user experience.
== Installation ==
1. Upload the plugin files to the `/wp-content/plugins/image-scroll-reveal` directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly. 2. Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' screen in WordPress 3. Add the "Image Scroll Reveal" block to any post or page 4. Upload your top and bottom images 5. Customize the reveal direction and fade settings in the block sidebar
== Frequently Asked Questions ==
= How do I change the reveal direction? =
In the block sidebar settings, you'll find a "Reveal Direction" option with four choices: Left, Right, Top, and Bottom. Select your preferred direction to change how the top image reveals the bottom image.
= Can I adjust the fade effect? =
Yes! The block includes a "Transition Fade Width" setting where you can specify the width of the fade effect in pixels. You can also choose different fade effect styles for various visual appearances.
= Will this work on mobile devices? =
Absolutely! The block is fully responsive and works smoothly on all devices. The images automatically adjust to maintain their aspect ratios on different screen sizes.
= Does the animation affect page performance? =
The animation is optimized for performance and uses efficient scroll event handling with throttling to ensure smooth scrolling without impacting page performance.
== Screenshots ==
1. Block editor interface showing image upload controls and sidebar settings 2. Example of left-to-right reveal animation in action 3. Sidebar settings panel with reveal direction and fade options 4. Before and after comparison using the scroll reveal effect
== Changelog ==
= 0.1.0 = * Initial release * Scroll-triggered reveal animation * Four reveal directions (left, right, top, bottom) * Customizable fade transition width * Full WordPress image settings support * Responsive design
== Advanced Usage ==
The block supports all standard WordPress image settings including: * Alt text for accessibility * Custom dimensions (width and height) * Border styles and colors * Spacing controls (margin and padding) * Link options to connect images to URLs
For best results, use images with the same dimensions or aspect ratios to ensure smooth transitions.

file.description: This file contains the block registration code in the form of a single block plugin. Any other plugin related functionality should be added to this file. All block rendering functionality should go to the `render.php` file.
file.content:
<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name:       Image Scroll Reveal
 * Description:       Create stunning scroll-triggered image reveal animations with customizable directions and fade effects.
 * Version:           0.1.0
 * Requires at least: 6.1
 * Requires PHP:      7.4
 * Author:            WordPress Telex
 * License:           GPLv2 or later
 * License URI:       https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
 * Text Domain:       image-scroll-reveal
 *
 * @package ImageScrollReveal
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

/**
 * Registers the block using the metadata loaded from the `block.json` file.
 * Behind the scenes, it registers also all assets so they can be enqueued
 * through the block editor in the corresponding context.
 *
 * @see https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/functions/register_block_type/
 */
function image_scroll_reveal_image_scroll_reveal_block_init() {
	register_block_type( __DIR__ . '/build/' );
}
add_action( 'init', 'image_scroll_reveal_image_scroll_reveal_block_init' );
